notes.title: “Boiling Steel” VR sci-fi shooter from MiroWin launched via Steam
notes.content:
MiroWin Studio, the developer of the popular Guns’n’Stories: Bulletproof VR, is proud to inform, that their latest VR FPS story-based VR shooter Boiling Steel is released in Steam in full version.

The plot
The story for “Boiling Steel” was written by one of the authors of S.T.A.L.K.E.R. series. According to the plot you’re one of many who set off in search of a better life in the distant bastion of scientific progress. On the colony planet, free from bureaucratic, religious and other radical restrictions they research and freely use industrial teleportation, transfer of consciousness and other technologies prohibited in the inhabited worlds. Factories, power plants, mines and residential complexes of the planet are fully automated. All the dirty and hard work is done by robotic shells controlled by the operator's mind. It is a high-tech paradise. But here, something went wrong...
Reach the final to know what’s happened.

In the full version you’ll find:

 11 tools, each with unique playstyle, upgrades, and handling, including the stripping cutter and PFG (the tool for the pit-stop refueling of the reactive thrusters of the industrial drones)
 the fisticuffs
 the gravity beam and dynamic objects that can be controlled using this beam.
 more than 40 combat missions equaling over 10 hours of action-packed VR shooting goodness.
 final part with 10 additional maps and not less than 1 hour of gameplay more.
 variety of dynamic interactions with objects
 experienced upgrade system. The more you use a tool, the more powerful it becomes. Be rewarded for sticking with a favorite.
 non-story missions are randomly generated to make each playthrough exciting and unique.
 a wide variety of enemy shells with a multitude of armaments, configurations, and combat style.
 overcome planetary security systems such as automated turrets, minefields, energy barriers, and more with smarts, quick reflexes, and puzzle-solving ability.
 explore cloud-city complexes, frozen structures, sandy mining platforms, and more.


Earlier the free mini-version Boiling Steel: Preface was released on Steam.

notes.title: 20% off Boiling Steel Developer Bundle is now available!
notes.content:
20% off Boiling Steel Developer Bundle is now available!

Discover the two most exciting VR experiences from MiroWin with the Boiling Steel Developer Bundle.

Boiling Steel
You are one of many who set off in search of a better life in the distant bastion of scientific progress. Your goal is a colony planet, free from bureaucratic, religious and other radical restrictions.
Here they research and freely use industrial teleportation, transfer of consciousness and other technologies prohibited in the inhabited worlds. Factories, power plants, mines and residential complexes of the planet are fully automated. All the dirty and hard work is done by robotic shells controlled by the operator’s mind. It is a high-tech paradise. But here, something went wrong...

Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof VR 
Guns’n’Stories: Bulletproof is a dynamic VR western shooter that fully immerses players into the ambiance of weird Wild West.
Stepping the tangled storyline, you will encounter many intimidating but comical enemies and fight Big Bosses.
You will have to shoot aptly and a lot using both hands as well as to use various covers and move actively, avoiding bullets of enemies.
You will visit many beautiful locations and will be able to try a big arsenal of weapons under the rhythm of the western rock music, jokes, and cynical humor!

With incredible visuals and endless playability, these games will keep you coming back for more!

notes.title: Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof VR HOTFIX
notes.content:
Greetings, cowboys!

A Hotfix is available for Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof VR today. This update will automatically install when starting the Steam client; if it doesn’t install automatically, please restart Steam. 

Fixed bug with not displaying stars for the completed levels after finishing Act 3 Level 3

We are committed to making playing Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof VR most comfortable and the best experience possible. We will continue to support the title. If you have any feedback on this update or just the game in general, please let us know in the Steam forums or comment below. Let your shot always hit the target!

notes.title: FRESH Update!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30284132/82e11a44965327818eda621fb3572a2981c7c50b.jpg

We are happy to announce a new update for Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof VR!
Patchnote:
The dynamic was improved and the duration of the 1st and 3rd levels of the 1st Act (1.1.1.3) was reduced. At level 1 of Act 1, now appears Grenadiers with dynamite.
Minor changes in waves at the 2nd level of the 2nd Act (2.2)
The weapon was changed: "Crossbow with Dynamite & Shotgun". Now, dynamite explodes on contact with the enemy, and the shotgun fire range increased, but the rate of fire is reduced.
Added a tutorial when a new weapon is received.
Minor fixes.
Corrected Chinese localization.
Added voice over to the Chinese.
Added localization to German, French, Italian, Spanish, Japanese languages.
Added an encyclopedia with the description of the different types of enemies and bosses.
Added an encyclopedia with the description of the various arsenal of weapon.

Have much fun and lucky shots, cowboys!

notes.title: The release version of Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof will be available in March 8!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30284132/486a426a11f139cdf9269952c099aa6b0bad34e1.jpg


Friends! 

We’ve been waiting for this moment for a long time and now we are happy to announce that the development of VR Western Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof is now on the finish line!

Looking back at the path that we have passed since the advent of the game in Early Access, we see as our project has grown up and we completely understand that we couldn't do this without your feedback and support.

As the special thanks, all owners of Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof will receive six bonus levels after the release – they will opened after the main storyline is completed. 
In addition to that, new guns, game features and achievements will also be added!

The release version of Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof will be available in March 8, 2018, in Steam and Oculus stores for $19.99!


Bonus levels:

 Cabaret: 

A hot spot that that may not survive the attack of bandits.
Players will have to keep the defense of the building trying to eliminate all enemies not allowing the heated bandits inside the building.
New enemies: Naked giants with hearts over their heads

 Whiskey Storage: 

Our whiskey is under the threat!
Bandits aim to stop the loading of boxes with whiskey on the rail station using a new type of drones. You can’t lose your whiskey!
New enemies: Drones wearing sombreros.

 Happy Farm: 

You have to protect the Bill's barn with his favorite piggy inside!
Bandits decided to harm Bill, sending to his farm squads with explosives.
New enemies: Bombers with dynamite.

 Bandits Camp: 

Sweet revenge!
Bill decides to take revenge on the robbers for the farm and strikes back! Bill is consistently teleported to the key points of the Camp, smashing everything on his way.

 Bank Robbery: 

There is no good without a bank robbery!
The gold stock of the entire state is under the threat, and the situation cannot be solved without Bill and his beloved guns.
All your reaction speed is required here. Your enemies can die from 1 or 2 nice shots but their shots do double-damage.

 Bill’s Nightmare: 

Well, hell!
Bill sees a nightmare in which he finds himself in the cemetery..
New enemies: Don’t worry, there will be no tiresome zombies.
New weapon: Six-barrel machine gun "Best Friend"


New game features:


 Digital indication  of the inflicted damage (can be turned off in the menu settings).
Now you will know for sure how much damage you do when hit the armor, head or a body. Oh, yeah, – the same goes for the hats!

 Stars:  
Everybody knows that the Sheriff Stars are never too much.
That is why we’ve decided to encourage the quick-fire shooters with not only scoring but also with sheriff stars. After each level!
The more points you gain the more stars you receive. (At the moment five stars were able to get only our lead programmer. Сheater!)

 Achievements: 
It’s no good to do without super-duper gaming achievements, whose memorable signs will decorate the honorable list of your trophies?
For instance, not everyone can lose in the first 30 seconds of the game! True?
You will have to play hard to collect them all!


Changes:

Increased damage from headshots.
We’ve decided to increase the damage from headshots, so that the most accurate shooters could sip their whiskey slowly, killing enemies from afar.
A bug with language selection is fixed.
Various skins for enemies.

notes.title: ACT III is out now!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30284132/d3056e1bc43f9b6b272153ab781808420a4b403c.png

 Friends!  

We took one more step on the way to the Final Release and are pleased to announce the release of the Third Act to the VR-western Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof!

In addition to full-fledged three levels that allow you to investigate Sintown in all its glory, we will make you happy with new cool guns and let you apply them in action.
New enemies and new gaming mechanics will not make you bored as you will have to work really hard!
But the most important thing is that completely re-made and improved graphics is waiting for you along with long-awaited optimization of the gaming process and tips for newcomers!

The next step is the release of The Game, in which we also have something to please you! 
Stay tuned and watch the news!

Details:

   Three new trials:

   Warfare in the Saloon
   Wall to Wall
   Obstacle Race


   New weapons: paired Tommy guns “Bella and Talula” and one of our favorites “Mrs. Jumbo”.

   New gaming mechanics: 

   Protection of objects. Whiskey boxes are in jeopardy. Don’t allow to empty them!
   Protection of allies. You lose if all your allies die!
   Chase! A hero is getting teleported to a new town’s location in the final round after each shooting.


   New types of enemies:

   Whiskey Man. He really loves whiskey, especially when it is free.
   Morticians. Don’t let them come too close to you. They are capable of many things in the close combat.


   A final boss. Harry.

   He is a nobleman to the bone. But you should keep your distance!


   The continuation of a story about good old Bill who always has what to tell ya.

 Gameplay and UX

 The indicator of the level's progress. Now you will know for sure when you have to cool the heated barrels!
 Support left-handed mode.


For those who want to personally try the full attractiveness of the gameplay together with updated graphics before buying a full version - the free version of a game is available for download: Guns’n’Stories: Preface.

 Tell us about your impressions! We always welcome your feedback!
